description: This file defines a command-line command for health probing within a Swift-based project, using the Commander framework. It sets up a 'health' command that, when invoked, prints 'ok'.

classes.name: HealthCommand
classes.description: A command-line command conforming to ParsableCommand that provides a health check feature.
